mechanism_narrative: Lower federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) directly reduce the risk-free rate used in equity valuation models, leading to higher present values and positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 0.3 percentage points over three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, prompting equity investors to anticipate lower corporate earnings and sell off S&P 500 positions, resulting in negative 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous weakness in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates a broad-based economic slowdown, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both INDPRO and HOUST are below their 12-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%) and elevated policy rates (FEDFUNDS > 1.5%), the Federal Reserve is likely to maintain or tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns as investors price in slower growth.
regime_hint: high inflation and high interest rates
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS > 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Strong housing market activity (HOUST) reflects robust consumer demand and business investment, which typically precedes higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST is above its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 1.0% over three months indicates a contraction in manufacturing and supply chain activity, causing investors to anticipate reduced corporate profits and sell S&P 500 positions, resulting in negative 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO falls > 1.0% in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous weakness in labor market growth (PAYEMS < 100k new jobs) and retail sales (RSAFS < 0.5% growth) indicates a broad-based consumer demand slowdown, triggering negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns as investors fear recession.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both PAYEMS < 100k and RSAFS < 0.5% growth.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of slowing GDP growth (GDPC1 annualized quarterly growth rate < 1.5%), the S&P 500 tends to underperform as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 annualized growth rate is below 1.5%.
